note: Style B: warm, intimate, boutique. Realistic but styled; dark wood and brass, evening light.
still: Vertical photo by a professional cafe content creator, shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera with a 50mm lens at f/2.8. An elegant boutique coffee bar in warm late-afternoon window light. A brushed-steel espresso machine with walnut handles on a dark walnut counter, immaculate and polished but real, portafilter locked in, a small handmade matte-black ceramic cup on a saucer centred under the spouts. The counter is clean and carefully styled: a folded linen napkin and a small brass spoon, nothing else. Softly out-of-focus shelves with neatly arranged ceramic cups behind. Rich but natural colours, soft shadows, inviting and premium, tidy. Authentic photograph, not a 3D render, not over-sharpened, no artificial glow, no bokeh light orbs. No people, no hands, no text, no logos, no brand names, no lettering anywhere on the machine.
motion: A slow, graceful push-in toward the black ceramic cup. Espresso begins to flow from the spouts in two fine, steady streams and fills the cup with a rich golden-brown crema. A faint wisp of steam rises through the warm window light. Shot on a mirrorless camera with a stabilised gimbal: steady, confident movement with natural micro-motion, not robotic. Real-time speed, true-to-life liquid, natural colours. No people, no hands, no text.
